content.text:
Fixed: `diffJson` no longer throws when an object has a truthy, non-callable `toJSON` property. The example from the report now produces a normal diff of `"toJSON": "old"` against `"toJSON": "new"`.

The cause was in `canonicalize` in `src/diff/json.ts`, which called `obj.toJSON()` whenever the property was truthy. It now checks `typeof obj.toJSON === 'function'` first, matching `JSON.stringify`.

I added a regression test for the reported case in `test/diff/json.js`; the full suite passes after rebuilding (302 tests).
